scenes.tekst: Does your rig use different bone names?
scenes.label: QUICK QUESTION

scenes.tekst: This robot's rig uses Mixamo style bone names.
scenes.label: BONE NAMES

scenes.tekst: Click Joints Pro knows the bone names of the common rigs.
scenes.label: KNOWS YOUR RIG

scenes.tekst: Rigify, Mixamo, Auto-Rig Pro, Unreal, Character Creator, VRoid, Biped and Daz.
scenes.label: EIGHT RIG TYPES

scenes.tekst: Press Figure from rig, and it finds the elbows, knees, shoulders, hips and neck.
scenes.label: ONE BUTTON

scenes.tekst: It cuts the robot into parts, with a joint at each one.
scenes.label: PARTS

scenes.tekst: Does a bone have a Limit Rotation? Then the hinge stops at that angle.
scenes.label: YOUR LIMIT

scenes.tekst: No limit on one side? It takes the limit of the other side.
scenes.label: MIRRORED

scenes.tekst: Drag Bend on the knee, and it stops at the angle from your rig.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Past the stop, red shows where parts would hit.
scenes.label: CHECK

scenes.tekst: Exploded view pulls the parts apart.
scenes.label: LOOK INSIDE
